notes: All allocations specified as veDOLO or oDOLO are modeled as standard DOLO
Community Incentives tracks oDOLO claims on Berachain
Community Incentives (TBD) refers to the remaining portion of the community incentives allocation
Future Partner Rewards have no defined schedule, modeled as TBD
Minerals Claimers represents tokens available via call options ($0.045 strike) exercisable for 6 months post-TGE
Treasury has no specified vesting schedule, modeled as unlocked at TGE and held by foundation
Service Providers have no specified vesting schedule, modeled as unlocked at TGE
Advisors vesting described as '2-3 years with a 1-year cliff', assumed 1-year cliff + 3 years linear
3% annual inflation starting after Year 4 is not modeled

Airdrop.methodology: Community airdrop distributed at TGE based on protocol usage

retroactive-usage.name: Retroactive Usage
retroactive-usage.methodology: 9% of supply distributed to early users (50% DOLO, 50% veDOLO)

early-contributors.name: Early Contributors
early-contributors.methodology: 1% distributed to early contributors at TGE

minerals-claimers.name: Minerals Claimers
minerals-claimers.methodology: 10% as call options at $0.045 strike, exercisable for 6 months post-TGE

Insiders.methodology: Team, advisors, and service providers with vesting schedules

Investors.methodology: Investor allocations with varying vesting schedules

short-vest-investors.name: Short Vest Investors
short-vest-investors.methodology: 1.4% vested linearly over 12 months from TGE

Community Incentives.methodology: Liquidity mining tracked on-chain on Berachain

liquidity-mining-odolo.name: Liquidity Mining - oDOLO (Berachain)
liquidity-mining-odolo.methodology: Tracks oDOLO claimed by users from the RollingClaims Merkle distributor via the Dolomite Event Emitter's RewardClaimed event.

Future Partner Rewards (TBD).methodology: 5.75% reserved for future partner integrations, no defined schedule

partner-rewards.name: Future Partner Rewards
partner-rewards.methodology: 5.75% reserved for future partner integrations, no defined schedule

Community Incentives (TBD).methodology: Remaining portion of the 20% liquidity mining allocation not yet distributed via oDOLO claims

liquidity-mining-tbd.name: Liquidity Mining (TBD)
liquidity-mining-tbd.methodology: 20% of supply allocated to liquidity mining, minus oDOLO already claimed by users
